style.backgroundSystem: flat misty powder-blue fields and warm cream panels, crossed by one diagonal mustard-yellow split band; hairline rounded frames and hairline keyline cards only
style.iconSystem: hairline single-stroke outline pictograms (paw print, bowl, pouch) inside plain soft-blue circles #BFDAEF, uniform weight, no gold rings, no filled 3D badges
style.lightingSystem: soft high-key cool daylight, broad front-left source, very low contrast, faint contact shadow only; no hard shadow, no dramatic rim light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft editorial pet-food ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of misty powder blue #DDE8F5, warm cream #F6F0E6 and deep charcoal ink #2B2B2B, with one mustard yellow diagonal accent #EBC958 and one soft dialogue blue #BFDAEF; cool high-key tone; bold Chinese display serif headlines with thin sans-serif sublabels; hairline single-stroke outline pictograms inside soft-blue circles; flat misty-blue and cream infographic panels crossed by one diagonal mustard band, hairline keyline cards; soft high-key cool daylight from front-left with faint contact shadow only; product rendered as a blank matte white stand-up pouch with zip top plus loose multi-shaped kibble, stable scale and centring; animals cropped at the chest or turned away so no individual is identifiable; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no wood, stone or clinical-blue gradient surfaces
no brand wordmark, QR code, membership or store-promo badge
no legible copy printed on the pouch
style.presentationRules: product shown as a blank matte white stand-up pouch with zip top plus loose multi-shaped kibble; stable pouch scale and centring; kibble colours limited to earthy brown, ochre, muted green and cream; animals always cropped at the chest or turned away so no individual reads as identifiable
style.surfaceSystem: seamless cream paper-matte surface #F6F0E6, occasionally met by a misty-blue #DDE8F5 band; no wood, no stone, no metal counter
style.typography: bold Chinese display serif for headlines in deep charcoal #2B2B2B, paired with thin sans-serif sublabels; one headline and two short labels maximum per screen
